title: datura stramonium var. inermis
intro: Datura stramonium var. inermis, commonly known as the prickly bittersweet nightshade, is a variety of the deadly nightshade plant, a perennial herb native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving rheumatism, and treating various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Datura stramonium var. inermis include acting as an analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent due to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids like scopoletin and scopoletin glycosides. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
